title: rosa pomifera subvar. gaudinii
intro: Rosa pomifera subvar. gaudinii, commonly known as Gaudin's wild rose or Chinese wild rose, is a species of rose plant that is native to China. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, making it a valuable plant in traditional Chinese medicine. The health benefits of Rosa pomifera subvar. gaudinii include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
